description: Start or continue oriiion onboarding, without login. Ask exactly the returned question and show its choices; carry returned answers into the next call. Append the chosen value, or null for the recommendation. Never invent user answers. Use finish when the user asks for the recommended plan. This completes starter planning only, not account setup or social authorization. OAuth unlocks existing account/channel tools. No background timer runs in an external MCP client: only call finish for silence if that client actually supports an agreed timeout.
